comments.content: AUTH ARCHITECTURE (researched, verified Aug 2026): ATProto OAuth, scope 'atproto' only (identity-only; consent reads 'wants to uniquely identify you'). Primary package @svelte-atproto/oauth 0.3.0 (SvelteKit-native, atcute-based, Cloudflare KV adapter, mounts /oauth-client-metadata.json + /oauth/{login,callback,logout} via hooks.server.ts, locals.did). Fallback: atproto-oauth-client-cloudflare-workers (patched NodeOAuthClient; stock @atproto/oauth-client-node does NOT run on workerd — issue #3292 open). Flow: PAR+DPoP+PKCE all mandatory; client-metadata.json served at client_id URL, token_endpoint_auth_method none, dpop_bound_access_tokens true, grant_types [authorization_code] only. Storage: KV namespace for state/session (TTL); DISCARD oauth session at callback — mint our own signed HTTP-only cookie {did, handle, displayName, avatar}. Profile: GET public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.actor.getProfile?actor=<did> — UNAUTHENTICATED, returns displayName + avatar CDN URL. Survey responses in D1 keyed by DID. nodejs_compat flag required. Do NOT use transition:* scopes. Dev: localhost client_id special-case via buildAtprotoLoopbackClientMetadata().

D1 SCHEMA (draft): table responses (did TEXT PK, handle TEXT, display_name TEXT, avatar_url TEXT, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, home_location TEXT NOT NULL, interest TEXT CHECK in yes/no/maybe, travel TEXT CHECK in yes/partial/no, location_ranking TEXT (JSON array of up to 3 of: palm-springs, coachella-valley, joshua-tree, san-diego, la-metro), submitted_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT). Table availability_ranges (id INTEGER PK, did TEXT REFERENCES responses ON DELETE CASCADE, start_date TEXT (ISO, within 2026-09-01..2026-11-15), end_date TEXT, start_portion TEXT CHECK in full/first_half/second_half, end_portion TEXT same — portions express half-day availability on a range's first and last day. Table allowlist (handle TEXT PK, did TEXT NULL — filled on first login). Config table or env for deadline date (TBD from Bryan).
